name: git_commit
description: Stage all changes in the workspace and commit them on the current branch with the given message. Never amends; if there is nothing to commit it reports success without creating an empty commit. The executor's .orchestration directory is already excluded from the repository.

detailed: Stages all workspace changes and commits them.
whimsical: Put a bow on the changes.

message.description: The commit message. Must be a non-empty string of at most 1000 characters.

timeoutSeconds.description: Optional timeout in seconds. Capped by the executor default tool timeout; a value above the cap is clamped to the cap.
